promptText: What tool matches this description: "Visit our CRM pricing page to discover which plan is best for your team's needs. ﻿Manage unlimited pipelines, starting from $10 per user a month."?
rawText:
This description belongs to **monday sales CRM** (by **monday.com**). 

Their "Basic CRM" plan starts at $10 per user/month (billed annually) and includes features like unlimited pipelines and contacts.
